code_note: sha256 of the scripts as committed beside this file (p2_matter_scripts/).  They grew during the work: earlier rows were made by earlier states that differ only in what was added later -- output fields (E_atoms), options (separate observed/aufbau spins, a fixed FFT mesh, the Mulliken switch, first-order extrapolation for an unbracketed crossing) -- so each banked row's numerical path is the committed script's at its defaults; the variable-mesh solid scans that the fixed mesh replaced are not banked
what: item 221: matter in position 2 -- the rows behind lemmas/p2_matter.py.  Molecules: UKS PBE0/def2-TZVP (+def2 ECP for Ag, Au), PySCF 2.14.  Solids: PBE, GTH-PBE pseudopotentials, GTH-DZVP-MOLOPT-SR, 4x4x4 k (irreducible wedge), Fermi smearing 0.01 Ha, 160 Ha cutoff on a fixed mesh per metal; d band on 8x8x8, smearing 0.005 Ha.  Position 2's law (RECONSTRUCTED): E' = E + delta (N_d - N_obs) on each exception atom, N_d its Lowdin d count; delta calibrated per method so the free atom's aufbau configuration lies 0.05 eV (min) or the NIST gap (mirror) below the observed one.  Computed 2026-10-11 in a scratch environment; read-only on the corpus.
